I will use the little manure I have from home, and if I can get fertilizer in a small share with another farmer, I will put a small amount because millet on this land responds when the rain is good. I will keep my local seed because that is what I know on this plot, and since it is rainfed millet mixed with other crops, I will not spend money on irrigation or spraying unless there is a serious problem.
